name: When should I consider getting an AEO website audit?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider getting an AEO website audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider an AEO website audit if your current digital visibility is stagnating, if you're launching a new website, or if you're experiencing changes in search engine algorithms. It's particularly crucial if you notice competitors gaining ground in AI-powered search, or if your website isn't effectively answering user queries through AI. An audit helps you proactively adapt to the evolving landscape of AI-driven information retrieval and maintain a competitive edge.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider an AEO audit if digital visibility is stagnant, launching a new site, or if competitors are gaining ground in AI search.
